antithesis: We can conclude that transcranial 870nm at 345 THz with low irradiance 22.2 mW/cm2 for 40 minutes is the most effective strategy validated by the 2024 paper showing complex IV +12%
synthesis: I believe that exposing keratinocytes to 850nm light at 353 THz could repair mitochondrial damage in PDH complex
conclusion: But prolonged exposure at 850nm might generate too much heat and damage surrounding tissue in keratinocytes
forward_action: But prolonged exposure at 850nm might generate too much heat and damage surrounding tissue in keratinocytes
